BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, tᵉshûwqâh is the word for longing, desire. In Genesis 3:16, thy desire shall be to thy husband. Across its 3 occurrences, the word keeps that same sense, whether the setting is promise or warning.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe desire itself is not the enemy; the question is always what my desire is set on. That is why I come back to tᵉshûwqâh whenever I need to remember what is true.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
